# Debezium

> > Debezium is an open-source distributed platform for change data capture (CDC) that streams database changes to Kafka for event-driven architectures.

Debezium provides low-latency data streaming connectors for multiple databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and SQL Server. The platform integrates with Apache Kafka to enable real-time database monitoring and event streaming for microservices architectures.

## Key Topics

- Change Data Capture (CDC)
- Apache Kafka
- Event Streaming
- Database Streaming
- Open Source
- Database Monitoring
- Kafka Connect
- MySQL Connector
- PostgreSQL Connector
- MongoDB Connector
- SQL Server Connector
- Real-time Data Integration
- Microservices Architecture
- Data Pipelines
- Distributed Systems
